name: task-workspaces
description: A faster, SSD-friendly alternative to the built-in worktrees of Codex and Claude Code: isolated Git worktrees per task across one or more repositories, sparse-checkout profiles per subproject, reused dependency installs via copy-on-write clones, checkpoints before cleanup and restore of removed folders.

worktrees_root.title: Task worktrees folder
worktrees_root.description: Where task worktrees are created. Must not have node_modules or package.json in a parent folder.

state_dir.title: State folder
state_dir.description: Registry, manifests and checkpoints. Kept when the plugin is uninstalled.

dependency_strategy.title: Dependency preparation
dependency_strategy.description: auto: copy-on-write clone of a verified install when possible, otherwise install; clone; install; none.

disk_reserve_gib.title: Free space reserve (GiB)
disk_reserve_gib.description: New trees, restores and installs are refused if they would leave less free space than this.

cleanup_mode.title: Automatic cleanup
cleanup_mode.description: on-use: clean up idle tasks in the background while wsp is used (no service); scheduled: a launchd/systemd user job (wsp janitor install); off: only by hand.

integration.title: Integration
integration.description: Optional: repo-map imports repositories from a Markdown table (set its path with `wsp init --repo-map FILE`).
